scope: Deterministic kernel, file, formatting, stress, attached-host AWT/Compose tests, and compiled Argon regression probes against the isolated build; not physical OS IME qualification

findingsDispositions.title: Partial-commit composition abort data loss on retained original segments
Empty-paragraph typing style stored on PARAGRAPH_BREAK inline style flags
findingsDispositions.baselineOutcome: PARAGRAPH_BREAK.style held inline bold/italic flags for empty-paragraph typing metadata
findingsDispositions.repairedOutcome: PARAGRAPH_BREAK.style is invariant TextStyleFlags(bold=false, italic=false); paragraph-level typing style is stored in TextUnit.paragraphStyle and persisted in .astra v3 with v1/v2 migration

findingsDispositions.title: paragraphBaseDirection ignored UAX #9 directional isolate scopes (LRI/RLI/FSI..PDI)
Selection across only a PARAGRAPH_BREAK or empty paragraph rendered zero highlight rects
findingsDispositions.baselineOutcome:
0 highlight rectangles drawn for Selection(2, 3) on 'ab
cd' or Selection(2, 3) on 'ab

cd'
findingsDispositions.repairedOutcome: Geometry.breakAndEmptySelectionRects renders directional 8px*scale selection strips at the trailing edge of selected breaks and leading edge of selected empty paragraphs

findingsDispositions.title: Geometry.paragraphForOffset(offset, leadingAffinity=true) crossed separator and clamped negative local offset
findingsDispositions.baselineOutcome: At separator start offset 2 in 'ab\ncd', leadingAffinity=true jumped to paragraph 1 (startOffset=3) and clamped (2 - 3).coerceIn(0, 2) to local offset 0
findingsDispositions.repairedOutcome: Geometry.paragraphForOffset(documentOffset) deterministically maps p.endOffset to paragraph p at local offset p.textLength without cross-separator jumping

findingsDispositions.title: referenceMeasure reused production partitionParagraphs, paragraphBaseDirection, and paragraphAttributedDisplay
findingsDispositions.baselineOutcome: referenceMeasure delegated to production helpers and only swapped TextMeasurer
findingsDispositions.repairedOutcome: referenceMeasure independently splits on '\n', resolves UAX #9 base direction via java.text.Bidi, builds independent SpanStyle runs, and uses an uncached TextMeasurer(cacheSize = 0); RtlHostChecks also checks hardcoded independent expectations

findingsDispositions.title: Claimed scrolling-composition test had no active composition (marked == null)
findingsDispositions.baselineOutcome: Section 16 of RtlHostChecks scrolled committed text without active composition
findingsDispositions.repairedOutcome: RtlHostChecks Section 16 injects an active Urdu composition (marked != null) and verifies both getTextLocation and getLocationOffset shift by exact scroll delta (-40px) and hit-test inside the active preedit

findingsDispositions.title: EditorSurface.geometry() returned stale cached layout after surface.setSize() before Compose repaint
findingsDispositions.baselineOutcome: Calling surface.setSize(newW, newH) and querying surface.geometry() before a Compose paint pass returned cached Geometry for old dimensions
findingsDispositions.repairedOutcome: Geometry and ViewState track logical hostWidth and hostHeight; surface.geometry() invalidates and re-measures immediately when surface.width or surface.height changes

findingsDispositions.title: Soft-wrap boundary affinity missing; VK_END on wrapped line without spaces stopped at k-1
findingsDispositions.baselineOutcome: Selection lacked soft-wrap affinity; ParagraphLayout.getLineForOffset(k) resolved soft-wrap boundary k to line l+1, forcing EditorSurface.stops(g) to omit k on line l and land VK_END at k-1
findingsDispositions.repairedOutcome: Selection carries WrapAffinity (DOWNSTREAM | UPSTREAM); EditorSurface.stops(g) emits (k, WrapAffinity.UPSTREAM) at soft-wrap boundaries; Geometry.getLineForOffset and caret keep (k, UPSTREAM) on line l at its visual trailing edge

findingsDispositions.title: Concrete AWT host & InputContext retirement/replacement, settlement watchdog deadline preservation across candidate updates, and close/save hardening

baselineOutcome.75f5cb4: waiting had no timeout/recovery; late IME callbacks lacked retirement; WindowFiles.close() ignored active composition when dc == savedSnapshot; save(closeAfter=true) did not re-check active composition/revisions after write

repairedOutcome.summary: EditorSurface owns a dedicated InputContext, sets retired=true and detaches/disposes InputContext BEFORE endComposition() and engine.abortComposition() (rejecting both reentrant and delayed ordinary AWT InputMethodEvents), swaps in a fresh replacementSurface for subsequent input (including identical text), guards removeNotify() disposal, and preserves settlementRequestedAt across non-terminal candidate updates while pending commands remain

findingsDispositions.title: Claim that paragraphAttributedDisplay emits one SpanStyle per character without coalescing
findingsDispositions.verification: DesktopEditor.kt:47-53 loops `while (j < end && units[j].style == style) j++`, emitting 1 SpanStyle for 50 contiguous bold characters

findingsDispositions.title: Claim that Graphemes.stops omits caret stops for empty paragraphs
findingsDispositions.verification:
BreakIterator.getCharacterInstance produces boundaries after every '
'; Graphemes.stops("a

b") returns [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], including offset 2 for the empty paragraph

findingsDispositions.title: Claim that WindowFiles.open() replaces the current EditorEngine in place and orphans active composition
findingsDispositions.verification: WindowFiles.kt:59 opens a separate window via showEditor(initial = doc, initialPath = chosen) and never mutates the existing window's EditorEngine

findingsDispositions.title: Claim that a headless queue-filling probe proved Windows WInputMethod.endComposition() drops terminal callbacks
findingsDispositions.verification: Withdrawn: calling engine.command() 260 times in a headless test without delivering an InputMethodEvent only tests pendingQueue bounds, not Windows IMM32/TSF callback behavior

findingsDispositions.title: Neutral/empty paragraph base-direction inheritance across paragraphs
findingsDispositions.verification: Preserved per the Stage 2 contract and RtlHostChecks.kt:292-336 so pressing Enter or typing digits/punctuation after an Urdu/Arabic paragraph stays right-aligned

findingsDispositions.title: Handling of non-character keyPressed events during active composition
findingsDispositions.verification: Preserved VK_LEFT/navigation during composition (HostChecks.kt:35) while routing Escape to requestEndComposition() (and abortAndRetireComposition() when waiting/timed out)
